book_exercises.subtitle_fa: تمرین‌های این بخش را کامل کنید. هر تمرین دکمهٔ «بررسی پاسخ» خودش را دارد.
book_exercises.subtitle_en: Complete the exercises below. Each exercise has its own Check Answer button.

question.en: His new car is ___ than my car.
question.fa: ماشین جدید او از ماشین من ___ است.

explanation.fa: برای مقایسهٔ دو چیز از «faster» استفاده می‌کنیم.

question.en: Russia is ___ country of the world.

explanation.en: Use 'the biggest' for comparing more than two things.
explanation.fa: برای مقایسهٔ بیش از دو چیز از «the biggest» استفاده می‌کنیم.

statement.en: Learning about endangered animals is not important.
statement.fa: یادگیری دربارهٔ حیوانات در خطر انقراض مهم نیست.

correction.en: Learning about endangered animals is important.
correction.fa: یادگیری دربارهٔ حیوانات در خطر انقراض مهم است.

statement.en: You can do voluntary work in wildlife parks.
statement.fa: شما می‌توانید در پارک‌های حیات وحش کار داوطلبانه انجام دهید.

correction.en: You can do voluntary work in wildlife parks.
correction.fa: شما می‌توانید در پارک‌های حیات وحش کار داوطلبانه انجام دهید.

text.en: She ___ (work) in a hospital every week.

instruction.en: Choose the best sentence in each pair.
instruction.fa: از هر جفت، بهترین جمله را انتخاب کنید.

items.question: Choose the sentence that correctly uses an adjective.
Choose the sentence that correctly expresses the given comparison.
options: Our house is the smallest of all.
Our house is as small as their houses.

items.question: Choose the sentence that correctly expresses the given comparison.
options: David is taller than his father.
David is as tall as his father.

items.question: Choose the sentence that correctly expresses the given comparison.
options: The blue pencil is longer than the yellow pencil.
The yellow pencil is as short as the blue pencil.

instruction.en: Make sentences about people, things, or places you know using these adjectives.
instruction.fa: با این صفت‌ها دربارهٔ افراد، اشیا یا مکان‌هایی که می‌شناسی جمله بساز.

instruction.en: Write the comparative and superlative forms of each adjective.
instruction.fa: شکل تفضیلی و عالی هر صفت را بنویسید.

instruction.en: Complete each sentence with the comparative or superlative form of the word in the box.
instruction.fa: جمله‌ها را با شکل تفضیلی یا عالی کلمهٔ مناسب کامل کنید.

items.text: Pluto is ______ than the moon of Earth.
Are you sure this is the ______ way of doing it?
Lions are ______ animals in the world.
This lake is ______ one in the world.
A plane ticket is ______ than a train ticket.

instruction.en: Complete each sentence with the correct adjective. One adjective is extra.
instruction.fa: جمله‌ها را با صفت مناسب کامل کنید. یک صفت اضافه است.

items.text: She looked at the ______ sky above the sea.
Be ______! Look both ways when you cross the street.
Mary lost her ______ watch in the park.
